method.counter_units: All five timing counters are milliseconds. No similarly named exclusive scopes are substituted.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank: sorted[ceil(p*n)-1]; median uses the mean of the middle pair when n is even.
method.thresholds: Strictly greater than 16.667, 33.333 and 50.0 ms; denominator is all numeric samples in each group.
method.gameplay_filter: RunActive == 1 and Phase in 1..6; station, hangar and dead frames excluded.
method.gameplay_warmup_filter: Exclude frames whose start (cumulative FrameTime) is less than warmup seconds after each contiguous gameplay interval starts.
method.startup_filter: Non-gameplay frames with cumulative FrameTime start below startup warmup; this is an explicit time window, not a loading detector.
method.zero_timing_values: Retained and counted, including unavailable startup GPU/thread samples recorded as zero by Unreal.
method.frame_index: Zero-based CSV data-row index; repeated headers and metadata are excluded.

effective_frame_limit.meaning: Target frame budget, NOT actual frame time or simulation delta (UE LaunchEngineLoop.cpp).
effective_frame_limit.note: CSV targetframerate metadata is retained separately; it can differ from the applied runtime cap.

simulation_delta.reason: Fixture actor DeltaSeconds from normal engine frames; excludes startup/CSV drain. This is not physical input latency.

endgame_fixture.limits: Marker identifies a seeded scripted fixture with enlarged durability; counts include telegraphs/offscreen actors. It does not establish contact, visibility, natural progression, fairness or human feel.

log_evidence.boundary_note: CSV endtimestamp has whole-second precision; log cutoff includes that UTC second.

operator_context: Explicit seeded endgame fixture with enlarged durability and scripted controls; no natural progression/feel claim.
limits: Only the phases/waves listed above were captured; recorded fixture phases do not establish a natural full ten-wave run or representative performance acceptance.
A capped sample or scripted fixture is not evidence of uncapped headroom, representative worst-case performance or a sustained 60 FPS gate pass.
No physical input responsiveness, controller feel, natural gameplay acceptance, final-art approval or clean-machine benchmark is established.
RunActive/Phase identify simulation state, not a menu-open flag; live gameplay menus can be included. Loading/menu separation uses stated state/time filters.
GPU and thread counters can reflect pipelined earlier work and must not be summed or treated as exact causal attribution for one frame.

fixture_receipt.fixture: Fixed seed 5eade000000000000000000000000010; starter/RapidLaser; five Tier V paths; OverdriveCooling; base hull/shield 50000; seeded end of Wave8; no contract/events. Normal wave timings, 40s climax, caps, budgets, spatial admission and damage. Scripted shallow strafe, boost/brake cycles, dodge/8s and fire2s/6s. Kind presence includes telegraphs/offscreen actors. No station docking or natural balance/input/feel acceptance.
